question: Does learning a shared context for two alternatives or similarity to training-only landmarks add signal to the surviving linear frozen representation?
methods: Apply each new feature map to both available generic encoders. Context crosses the signed difference with the pair midpoint on twelve PCA directions learned only on the fitting partition. Landmarks compare both alternatives at two bandwidths with 128 training-only landmarks each. Every candidate keeps the same lexical features and the same linear regularization. Equal blending with the preceding reference is eligible.
comparison: Reuse the preceding screen's verified single model on each matched fold. Lock the two strongest single or blended alternatives on the first fold, confirm on the second, and confirm the surviving choice on the third, using the exact gates and tie-breakers of protocol.json. Four discovery fits and at most three more fits. The designated validation and official test are unavailable to selection. This is a development screen, separate from autonomous execution.
production: Expose both maps by representation capability in the anonymous catalogue. Decide later whether to admit this library variant to a new cold run using training feedback, before any designated labels are opened.
